description: Let \(f:M\to N\) be elementary and let the finite set \(A\subseteq N\) lie in its range. Every complete finite-tuple type \(p\) over \(A\) has a pullback \(q\) over a finite \(B\subseteq M\) with \(f[B]=A\); for every tuple in \(N\), realizing \(q\) through this same \(f\) is equivalent to realizing \(p\).
